rules: Render each level over its immediate lower level; do not composite the alpha into grass.
Level1 reserves two bottom blocks per column for the unchanged original face; the optional outer wall-side corners affect only that corner.
Reserve bottom rows according to height_profiles.json: default level2 one block, levels3-5 two blocks. Their own rim replaces any S cap above.
On a no-shelf stack, the lower step rim starts immediately beneath the upper step foot.
A side wall replaces exactly the W or E 8px half. Copy the opposite two phase quarters unchanged.
Side front ends are above the chamfered outer step or wall corners; use the directional artwork, never mirror W into E.
Map boundaries continue the same level and must not create a wall or step.
